Painted as a Yuan-dynasty literati painting, ink and light colour on paper.
montecorvino-archbishop: 1307, Khanbaliq (Dadu): a small European-style church with a bell tower among the Chinese tiled roofs of the city, a Franciscan friar in a brown habit, seen from behind, leading a procession of local converts in Mongol and Han dress carrying candles and a cross, children singing; Mongol officials in deels watch from the street. Clear spring day, figures small to middle distance. The scene fills the whole picture with no border, margin or cartouche. Painted in the style of a medieval illuminated miniature, gold leaf and bright colours.
yuan-exams: 1313-1315, Dadu (Beijing): in a great examination hall, rows of candidates in robes, including Han and Mongol scholars, sit at small desks writing with brushes on blank paper, officials patrolling, a courtyard with old cypresses outside. Spring morning, quiet focus, no legible text. Proctors in black caps stand at the doors, and attendants bring water and ink. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty court genre painting, ink and light colour on silk.
wang-zhen-nongshu: 1313, Jingde (Xuancheng): a magistrate-scholar in robes supervises craftsmen arranging wooden movable type pieces on a large revolving circular table, while farm tools such as ploughs, waterwheels and threshing devices stand in the courtyard; green fields outside. Daylight, no legible text. Assistants pick type pieces from numbered compartments while others ink and print pages on a bench nearby. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty genre painting, ink and light colour on silk.
nanpo-incident: 1323, Nanpo near Shangdu: a summer encampment on the steppe at night, a great imperial felt tent among many yurts, armed Mongol nobles with torches gathering outside, horses restless; the scene seen from afar, no violence shown. Starry sky, grassland hills. Guards at the edge of the camp look toward the tent in alarm, and a few riders gallop away into the dark. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and pale colour on silk.
da-yuan-tongzhi: 1323, Dadu (Beijing): in a government hall, Mongol and Han officials in robes compile a law code, clerks copying bound volumes at long tables, piles of case records, a senior official reviewing a completed set; red pillars and screens. Calm daylight, no legible text. Assistants carry bundles of documents across the courtyard. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty court genre painting, ink and light colour on silk.
two-capitals-war: 1328, the road between Dadu and Shangdu: two Mongol armies with banners clash at a mountain pass in the Yanshan range, cavalry charging across the slopes, rugged ridges and the steppe beyond. Autumn, dust, distant view, no gore. Fortified pass gates and watchtowers of the Juyong Pass guard the valley below, and supply carts wait on the road. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll in the manner of Liu Guandao, ink and colour on silk.
exams-abolished: 1335, Dadu (Beijing): an empty examination hall with rows of abandoned desks and closed doors, a few disappointed scholars in robes leaving through the gate with bundles, Mongol guards watching; autumn leaves blowing in the courtyard. Melancholy mood. An official notice board stands blank beside the gate, a servant sweeps leaves, and pigeons settle on the empty steps of the hall. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty genre painting, ink and pale colour on paper.
toghto-reforms: 1340, Dadu (Beijing): officials in robes reopen an examination hall gate as scholars return, while in a palace hall nearby, historians gather around tables with bound volumes; a Mongol chancellor in fine robes, seen from behind, watches from steps. Spring, hopeful mood, no legible text. Cypress trees shade the courtyard. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty court painting, ink and light colour on silk.
baimao-flood: 1344, Baimao near Cao County: the Yellow River bursts through its dikes and floods across the Shandong-Henan plain, villages, salt works and a canal submerged, peasants escaping on rafts and boats with oxen. Summer rain, grey sky, vast scale, no corpses. A broken section of the Grand Canal embankment and flooded salt pans lie in the distance, with officials surveying from a raised mound. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty landscape handscroll, ink and pale wash on silk.
three-histories: 1345, Dadu (Beijing): in an imperial history office, scholars in robes, both Mongol and Han, sit at long tables writing and collating three large sets of bound volumes, shelves of archives behind; a chancellor in robes, seen from behind, reviews the work. No legible text. Assistants carry finished volumes in cloth cases into a storeroom. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty court genre painting, ink and light colour on silk.
ibn-battuta-quanzhou: 1345, Zaitun (Quanzhou): a large junk arrives in the crowded harbour, a traveller in a North African turban and robe, seen from behind among other merchants, steps onto the wharf; hundreds of junks, mosques, temples and warehouses fill the shore. Bright day, busy port. Porters carry bales of silk and porcelain crates, and a Chinese customs official in robes inspects papers at the quayside. Painted as a Persian miniature-style manuscript illustration, flat colours and gold.
fang-guozhen: 1348, the Zhejiang coast near Taizhou: a fleet of rebel junks with matting sails emerges from rocky islands, intercepting grain ships at sea; sailors in short jackets with spears on deck. Stormy sky, rough waves, distant view, no gore. Grain sacks are hauled from the captured ships, the rebel banners snapping in the wind, and a coastal fort sits on a distant headland. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and light colour on silk.
daoyi-zhilue: 1349, Quanzhou: a returning traveller in robes, seen from behind, sits in a harbour-side study writing notes on a long scroll, while souvenirs from many lands lie around him: coral, spices, textiles, a ship model; ocean junks visible through the window. No legible text. A map-like drawing of coastlines without any writing lies on the floor. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty genre painting, ink and light colour on silk.
fuchun-mountains: 1350, the Fuchun River near Fuyang: rolling hills along a broad river, scattered pine groves, small thatched pavilions, a fisherman in a little boat, and a lone figure on a bridge; mist between the hills. Calm autumn. Grass-dotted slopes and long horizontal brushstrokes give an airy calm. Painted in the style of a Yuan-dynasty literati handscroll after Huang Gongwang, ink and pale ochre on paper, dry brush.
zhizheng-paper-money: 1350, Dadu (Beijing): a market street where merchants refuse paper notes, piles of near-worthless banknotes swept aside, townspeople bartering grain for cloth and salt; shops with half-shuttered fronts, worried faces seen at a distance. Overcast day, no legible text. A money changer's table stands empty, and porters carry baskets of grain and bolts of cloth for exchange, rice prices implied by the crowds at a granary. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty genre handscroll, ink and pale colour on paper.
jia-lu-yellow-river: 1351, Huangling Gang near Lankao: tens of thousands of labourers in short jackets with baskets and shovels close a breach in the Yellow River dike, rows of boats filled with stones sunk in the channel, officials on horseback supervising. Grey sky, vast scale, small figures. Officials in robes watch from a dike top, and long lines of labourers carry reed bundles. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and pale colour on silk.
xu-shouhui-tianwan: 1351, Qishui (Qichun) in the hills north of the Yangtze: crowds of rebels wearing red head-cloths and carrying spears gather on a hillside near a village, a red banner raised, Buddhist temple roofs in the background. Morning mist, crowd at a distance. A few riders gallop off to spread the news, and villagers bring food. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and light colour on silk, red accents.
zhu-joins-guo: 1352, Haozhou (Fengyang): a young man in a worn monk's robe walks through the gate of a walled town where rebel soldiers with red head-cloths drill in a courtyard; banners and simple houses, hills behind. Spring, dusty road, small figures. A guard at the gate questions him, and a crowd of recruits waits to enlist under the banners. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty genre painting, ink and light colour on paper.
zhang-shicheng: 1353, Taizhou in the Jiangsu salt marshes: salt workers and boatmen with poles and carrying baskets rise up, crowding along canals between salt pans and boiling sheds; a walled town on the horizon. Grey sky, crowd seen from a distance. Boatmen raise oars and poles above their heads, and salt officials' offices burn with thin smoke beyond the marsh. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and pale colour on silk.
siege-of-gaoyou: 1354, Gaoyou by the Grand Canal: a vast Yuan army with countless banners and tents encircles the walled city beside Gaoyou Lake; a messenger arrives with a court order and soldiers begin to break camp. Winter, flat landscape, distant view, no gore. Inside the city, defenders on the walls watch the enemy camp, and boats move along the canal. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and pale colour on silk.
han-liner-song: 1355, Bozhou in northern Anhui: a crowd of Red Turban soldiers with red head-cloths and banners kneels before a young man in imperial robes, seen from afar on a platform, in a walled town; smoke from incense. Spring, festive mood. Drummers beat time, and townspeople climb onto roofs to watch the crowd. Painted as a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, ink and light colour on silk, red accents.
cn-madman-diary: 1918, Beijing: a small study in a grey-brick courtyard house on a winter night, an oil lamp on a wooden desk with a brush, an inkstone and loose manuscript sheets, a stack of thin journals beside them, a man in a long scholar's gown seen from behind bent over his writing, a bare date tree and tiled roofs outside the lattice window under falling snow. Rendered as a Republican-era black-and-white woodcut print in the manner of Lu Xun's woodcut movement, bold carved lines, deep shadows.
cn-first-united-front: 1924, Guangzhou: a single view of delegates in long gowns, Western suits and Sun Yat-sen tunics gathering in the sunlit courtyard of a columned colonial-era hall, a crowd of small figures seen from a distance, palm trees and arcaded shopfronts behind, the Pearl River with sampans glimpsed at the end of the street. One continuous scene with no panels or insets, no legible text. Painted as a 1920s watercolour sketch, warm humid light, loose washes of ochre and green.
cn-may-thirtieth-movement: 1925, Nanjing Road, Shanghai: a long crowd of students in pale gowns and workers in jackets fills the street between stone department-store facades and tram lines, holding plain unlettered banners, seen from high above; a line of turbaned and helmeted Settlement policemen stands far off before a police station, a faint haze over the street. No injuries shown. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print, strong black and white contrast, dense rhythmic crowd forms.
cn-shanghai-purge: 1927, Shanghai: a grey April dawn over the lanes of Zhabei, shuttered workers' tenements and factory chimneys, armed soldiers in Nationalist uniforms and men in dark civilian clothes moving along an empty street in the distance, a few overturned chairs and scattered papers outside a closed union hall, smoke rising faintly beyond the rooftops. Rendered as a sombre Republican-era woodcut print, heavy black masses, stark carved lines, no figures in close-up.
cn-nanjing-government: 1927, Nanjing: a modest government compound of grey brick and colonnaded buildings behind the old city walls, a plain flag raised on a tall pole in the courtyard, officials in long gowns and military officers in peaked caps standing in small groups at a distance, rickshaws waiting at the gate, Purple Mountain blue on the horizon under clear spring sky. Painted as a 1920s Chinese watercolour sketch, soft washes, quiet documentary mood.
cn-nanchang-uprising: 1927, Nanchang: the hot night of 1 August, soldiers in grey cotton uniforms with white neckerchiefs and rifles move through the streets toward a large colonial-style hotel used as headquarters, lanterns and lit windows, the Gan River and old city walls dim beyond, figures small and seen at a distance, no fighting shown in close-up. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print with blue-black ink, dramatic night lighting carved in white lines.
cn-academia-sinica: 1928, Nanjing: scholars in long gowns and a few in Western suits gather in a simple lecture room of a new research institute, tables with microscopes, maps, rock specimens and bound books, tall windows opening onto plane trees, one elder seated at the head of the table seen from behind. Painted as a 1930s Shanghai-style lithograph illustration in muted sepia, browns and soft greens, fine cross-hatching, calm academic atmosphere.
cn-peking-man: 1929, Zhoukoudian near Beijing: a winter afternoon in a deep limestone cave excavation, workers in padded cotton jackets with pickaxes and baskets on wooden ladders and scaffolding, a young archaeologist kneeling by candlelight beside a pale fossil skullcap emerging from the earth, bare hills and a small village below. Painted as a Republican-era watercolour sketch, cold grey and ochre washes, warm candle glow inside the cave.
cn-central-plains-war: 1930, the Henan plain near Zhengzhou: long columns of soldiers in grey uniforms and puttees march along a dusty railway embankment beside an armoured train, horse-drawn artillery and mule carts follow, distant smoke from artillery over the flat wheat fields, a walled county town on the horizon, all figures small. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print, wide horizontal composition, bold carved earth and sky.
cn-chinese-soviet-republic: 1931, Ruijin, Jiangxi: a large crowd of peasants, Red Army soldiers in grey caps and villagers gather on a threshing ground before an old clan ancestral hall with upturned eaves, plain red banners without writing hung from the beams, rice paddies and green hills around, all seen from a distance in winter sunlight. Rendered as a Republican-era coloured woodcut print, red and black inks on cream paper, simple strong shapes.
cn-zunyi-conference: 1935, Zunyi, Guizhou: a grey-brick two-storey Western-style mansion with arched verandas on a narrow winter street, lamplight in an upstairs window at night, soldiers in worn grey uniforms with straw sandals standing guard outside, mist over the surrounding karst hills, the meeting room unseen. Painted as a muted watercolour sketch in the Republican style, blue-grey night tones, a single warm window glowing.
cn-fabi-reform: 1935, the Bund area of Shanghai or Nanjing: inside a high-ceilinged bank hall with marble counters and brass grilles, clerks in long gowns stack wrapped rolls of silver dollars and silver ingots into wooden crates for transfer, while customers in suits and qipaos receive bundles of new paper banknotes without legible print, ceiling fans turning. Rendered as a 1930s Shanghai lithograph illustration, fine line and soft sepia tones.
cn-battle-of-shanghai: 1937, Shanghai: autumn view across Suzhou Creek toward Zhabei, a tall concrete warehouse and rows of burned shophouses under drifting black smoke, distant aircraft in a grey sky, refugees with bundles crossing a bridge toward the foreign concessions where Western buildings stand intact, all figures small. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print in black and dark red, stark contrast, sombre wartime mood without visible casualties.
cn-taierzhuang: 1938, Taierzhuang, southern Shandong: an old walled canal town on the Grand Canal in spring, Chinese soldiers in grey uniforms and German-style helmets moving among broken mud-brick walls and alleys, distant smoke rising from the town, willow trees by the canal, a few abandoned Japanese tanks far off in the fields. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print, bold carved lines, crowded rooftops and canal reflections.
cn-yellow-river-flood: 1938, Huayuankou on the Yellow River: a vast brown flood spreading across the flat North China plain from a breach in the high earthen dike, the tops of willow trees, mud-walled villages and roofs standing out of the water, families with bundles on rafts and on the dike top watching from afar under an overcast sky. Rendered as a sombre Republican-era woodcut print, wide horizon, swirling carved water lines, no bodies shown.
cn-battle-of-wuhan: 1938, Wuhan: autumn on the Yangtze, the wide river crowded with steamers, junks and barges carrying soldiers, machinery and evacuees upstream, the Hankou waterfront of colonial customs houses and warehouses behind, smoke rising on the far hills, small aircraft in the sky. Cranes on the docks load crates aboard. Painted as a Republican-era watercolour sketch, grey-blue river mist and muted ochre, many small figures.
cn-chongqing-bombing: 1939, Chongqing: a May evening on the steep peninsula where the Yangtze and Jialing meet, stilted wooden houses clinging to the cliffs, people filing into tunnel air-raid shelters cut into the rock, searchlight beams and distant aircraft above, smoke and fire glow over the far rooftops, all figures small. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print in black with a touch of orange, dramatic but restrained.
cn-burma-road: 1938, the Yunnan mountains west of Kunming: thousands of labourers, men and women in blue cotton and straw hats, build a gravel road by hand along switchback curves on a steep green mountainside, carrying stones in baskets on shoulder poles and rolling a huge stone roller, a deep gorge and mist below. Painted as a Republican-era watercolour sketch, layered blue-green mountains, many tiny figures.
cn-hundred-regiments-offensive: 1940, the Taihang mountains near Yangquan, Shanxi: night along a railway in a loess valley, small groups of Eighth Route Army soldiers in grey uniforms and cloth caps pry up rails and topple telegraph poles, a blockhouse on a distant ridge, fire glow from a bridge far away under a moonlit sky. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print, carved black and white, angular mountain forms.
cn-new-fourth-army-incident: 1941, the mountains of southern Anhui near Jing County: a cold January landscape of forested ridges and mist, a long column of soldiers in grey padded uniforms winding along a narrow valley path, smoke rising from distant gunfire on the surrounding hills, bare trees and snow patches, all figures tiny. Rendered as a sombre Republican-era woodcut print, dense carved textures, grey winter mood.
cn-cairo-conference: 1943, Cairo: the garden terrace of a villa near the Giza pyramids in November, three small seated figures and their aides in suits and uniforms seen from a distance under shade, palm trees, staff cars and guards around, the pyramids hazy on the horizon. Painted as a 1940s documentary watercolour, warm desert light, sand and pale green tones, no faces in detail.
cn-operation-ichigo: 1944, Hengyang, Hunan: summer siege of a walled riverside city on the Xiang River, smoke over tiled roofs, distant columns of troops and trucks on the surrounding red-earth hills, refugees with carts and shoulder poles streaming along a road among rice paddies, figures small. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print, carved black lines with a muted red wash, broad landscape view.
cn-taiwan-retrocession: 1945, Taipei: an October morning outside the grand red-brick Taipei City Hall with its central tower, rows of Chinese officers and officials in uniform and Japanese officers in field uniforms standing in formation at a distance, crowds of Taiwanese townspeople watching along a palm-lined avenue. Painted as a 1940s documentary watercolour, bright subtropical light, red brick and green palms, many small figures.
cn-chongqing-negotiations: 1945, Chongqing: a hillside residence with a veranda shaded by banyan trees above the misty Jialing River, two small figures in a tunic suit and a uniform walking side by side on a garden path seen from behind, aides and guards following at a distance, steep city roofs below in autumn haze. Painted as a muted 1940s watercolour, soft grey-green tones, quiet atmosphere.
cn-228-incident: 1947, Taipei: a street of Japanese-era arcaded shophouses at dusk, a scattered crowd of townspeople in shirts and wooden clogs gathered at a distance around an overturned tobacco stall and spilled cartons, shutters closing, a tense empty foreground with a single bicycle, bare streetlamps. Rendered as a restrained black-and-white woodcut print in the style of 1940s Taiwanese prints, no violence shown.
cn-gold-yuan: 1948, Shanghai: a long queue of anxious people in coats and qipaos winds along a pavement outside a stone-faced bank on a cold autumn morning, some carrying cloth bundles, a man with a basket piled with banknote bundles without legible print, a tram and rickshaws passing. Rendered as a 1940s Shanghai lithograph illustration, grey sepia tones, crowded street and tired faces at a distance.
cn-liaoshen-campaign: 1948, Jinzhou, Liaoning: autumn on the Manchurian plain, long columns of soldiers in padded uniforms with rifles advance across harvested sorghum fields toward a walled city, artillery smoke drifting over its walls, horse carts and supply wagons behind, a railway line crossing the plain. Rendered as a Republican-era woodcut print, wide horizon, carved black and ochre inks, all figures small.
cn-huaihai-campaign: 1948, the plains around Xuzhou: a winter landscape of frozen fields and villages, endless lines of civilian labourers pushing wooden wheelbarrows of grain and supplies along rutted roads behind the front, soldiers in padded coats among them, distant smoke on the horizon. Rendered as a woodcut print in the style of the late 1940s, strong diagonal rhythms of carts and figures, black and white.
cn-pingjin-campaign: 1949, Beiping: the great grey Qianmen gate tower and the city wall on a cold January day, a column of soldiers in padded uniforms marching in through the gate past onlookers in padded jackets, intact roofs and streets, camel trains and carts on the road, a sense of calm entry. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, cold blue sky, grey brick and ochre tones.
cn-yangtze-crossing: 1949, the Yangtze near Nanjing: a night in late April, hundreds of wooden junks and sampans with patched sails crowded with soldiers cross the wide river under a moonlit sky, gun flashes on the far bank, the dark mass of Purple Mountain and city walls on the horizon. Rendered as a woodcut print, carved white waves and black water, many small boats.
cn-land-reform: 1950, a village in the North China countryside: peasants in padded jackets and work cadres measure out fields with wooden stakes, ropes and measuring sticks across a broad plain, a few families gathered around a field boundary with an abacus and bundles of papers, mud-walled houses and bare poplars behind, overcast sky. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, earthy browns and greys, neutral mood.
cn-volunteers-enter-korea: 1950, the Yalu River at Dandong: an October night, long columns of soldiers in padded khaki coats and fur caps with rifles and packs cross a long steel railway bridge and a pontoon bridge over the dark river into the hills of Korea, no lights, the town behind them. Rendered as a black-and-white woodcut print, carved river reflections, figures small and many.
cn-tibet-1951: 1951, Lhasa: the Potala Palace on its hill above the city in autumn, a long column of soldiers in khaki uniforms with pack animals entering the valley along a dirt road, Tibetan townspeople in chuba robes watching from the roadside and rooftops at a distance, prayer flags and barley fields, snow peaks beyond. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, clear thin mountain light, neutral observation.
cn-first-five-year-plan: 1953, northeast China: a vast new steel works under construction on a plain, blast furnaces, cranes and scaffolding against the sky, workers in cotton caps and overalls guiding steel beams, a few engineers in coats studying blueprints, a steam train hauling ore. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, smoky grey sky, rust and steel blue tones, figures small against the scale of industry.
cn-1954-constitution: 1954, Beijing: a large hall of the period filled with rows of seated delegates in tunic suits and colourful minority dress, seen from the back of the hall, a raised platform far ahead under red drapery, high windows letting in September light, a ballot box on a table in the aisle. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm reds and creams, no faces distinguishable.
cn-anti-rightist: 1957, the outskirts of a northern Chinese city: a quiet grey campus courtyard with long bulletin walls covered in large hand-written posters rendered as illegible abstract brush strokes, a few figures in tunic suits standing reading at a distance, bare trees, and beyond the walls a road leading to distant flat farmland. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, cold grey and pale ochre, subdued mood.
cn-tibetan-uprising-1959: 1959, Lhasa: a March view of the Potala Palace and the Norbulingka summer palace gardens from a distance, a large crowd of Tibetans in robes gathered before a walled compound gate, smoke drifting over the valley later, and far off on a mountain pass a small caravan of riders heading south into the snows. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, cold blue mountains, no violence depicted.
cn-sino-soviet-split: 1960, a Chinese industrial site: an unfinished factory hall with idle cranes and half-built concrete frames, Soviet engineers in hats and overcoats boarding a train with suitcases at a small station platform, Chinese workers watching quietly, scattered rolled blueprints left on a table. Summer dust drifts over the empty site. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, grey summer sky, quiet sense of departure.
cn-first-atomic-bomb: 1964, Lop Nur, Xinjiang: a mushroom cloud rising over a vast flat salt desert at dawn, seen from many kilometres away, a tall steel test tower silhouette far off, a few tiny figures in coats standing beside an observation bunker and trucks in the foreground, pale dunes and distant mountains. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, ochre and pale grey, quiet scale.
cn-down-to-countryside: 1968, northern China: a crowded railway platform in winter, young people in padded cotton coats and caps with bedrolls and enamel mugs boarding a long green train, families waving from the platform, steam hanging in the cold air, a water tower and snowy station roofs behind. One single continuous scene, no inset or panels. Figures at middle distance, faces not detailed. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, grey-blue winter tones, neutral and calm.
cn-zhenbao-island: 1969, the Ussuri River: a small wooded island in the middle of the frozen white river in March, distant figures in white snow camouflage on the ice, armoured vehicles on the far bank, thin smoke over the willows, flat snowy forest stretching to the horizon. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, icy whites, pale blues and dark tree lines, figures tiny.
cn-dongfanghong-1: 1970, Jiuquan launch site in the Gobi desert: a slender white three-stage rocket lifting off from a steel launch tower at night, a bright flame and plume lighting the flat desert, distant technicians and trucks silhouetted beside low buildings, a starry sky above. The flame reflects on gravel and sand. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, deep blue night with warm orange flame.
cn-un-seat: 1971, New York: the United Nations General Assembly hall in October, tiers of delegates' desks seen from the back, a large crowd of small figures standing and applauding, the gold-coloured emblem wall above the podium rendered without legible text, tall wood-panelled walls. Interpreters' booths line the upper walls, and papers lie scattered on desks. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm golds and blues, no recognisable faces.
cn-tangshan-earthquake: 1976, Tangshan, Hebei: a summer dawn after the earthquake, a wide view of flattened brick apartment blocks and factory buildings, workers, soldiers and townspeople clearing rubble with hand tools, tents of tarpaulin set up on the streets, light rain. No bodies shown. Trucks bring water drums, and a broken factory chimney stands alone. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, grey and dusty ochre tones, figures small.
cn-mao-death-gang-of-four: 1976, Beijing: Tiananmen Square in September seen from a distance, a vast silent crowd in white and dark clothing with black armbands, wreaths of white paper flowers stacked before the gate, the red walls and yellow roofs of the Forbidden City under an overcast autumn sky. Pigeons circle the square. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, greys and whites, calm and solemn.
cn-gaokao-restored: 1977, a Chinese county town in winter: a school classroom with wooden desks filled with examinees of very different ages, young workers and farmers in padded jackets bent over papers, a stove in the corner, frost on the windows, an invigilator walking between rows. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm stove light and cool grey winter tones, faces not detailed.
cn-household-responsibility: 1978, Xiaogang village, Anhui: a winter night in a mud-walled thatched farmhouse, a group of farmers in patched padded jackets gathered around an oil lamp, one pressing a red fingerprint onto a sheet of paper without legible writing, outside the window flat dry fields under moonlight. A low fire smoulders in the clay stove. Painted as a woodcut print in black and red, intimate and quiet.
cn-us-relations-1979: 1979, Washington, D.C.: a January day on the South Lawn of the White House, a welcoming ceremony with lines of honour guards in dress uniform, small figures of officials on a platform seen from a distance, the flags of both nations on poles, bare winter trees and the white portico behind. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, cold clear light, figures small.
cn-sino-vietnamese-war: 1979, near Lạng Sơn, northern Vietnam: a February landscape of steep limestone karst hills and misty valleys, columns of soldiers and trucks on a winding mountain road in the distance, smoke rising from a small town in the valley, rice paddies below. Water buffalo stand still in a flooded field, and banana trees line a village path. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, grey-green mist, no close fighting shown.
cn-shenzhen-sez: 1980, Shenzhen: a small border town of low tiled houses and fishponds beside rice fields, bulldozers levelling red earth hills and the first concrete frames rising, workers in straw hats, while across the river the high-rises of Hong Kong stand on the horizon. A narrow river marks the border. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, humid green and red earth tones, sense of transformation.
cn-one-child-policy: 1980, a Chinese city: a quiet residential lane of brick apartment blocks, a young couple from behind walking with a single small child between them, bicycles parked, laundry on bamboo poles, a plain wall with painted public-notice panels rendered as abstract colour shapes without writing. An old woman sits on a stool by a doorway. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft greys and faded reds, neutral mood.
cn-taiwan-martial-law-lifted: 1987, Taipei: a July day on a wide boulevard with scooters and buses, newspaper stands laden with many different papers whose mastheads are illegible, people reading on street benches, palm trees and 1980s concrete office buildings, the hills beyond in humid haze. Street vendors sell tea and small snacks under awnings. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, bright summer light, neutral everyday scene.
cn-southern-tour: 1992, Shenzhen: a January view of a fast-growing city, new glass-and-tile skyscrapers under construction with tall cranes, wide avenues with buses and bicycles, and a small group of officials walking along a waterfront promenade seen from far behind, their faces not visible. Banyan trees line the promenade, and ships crowd the harbour. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, bright winter sunshine, blue sky and pale buildings.
cn-three-gorges-dam: 1994 onward, near Yichang: the Yangtze between steep mountains at Sandouping, a colossal concrete dam under construction with cranes, scaffolding and cofferdams, trucks on haul roads, and upstream an old riverside town of stepped houses awaiting relocation, ships waiting on the river. Terraced orange groves climb the slopes above the river, and workers in hard hats move along the concrete. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, misty grey-green gorges, monumental scale.
cn-taiwan-1996-election: 1996, Taipei: a March day at a neighbourhood polling station set up in a school hall, voters of all ages queue with ID cards, wooden ballot boxes on tables, scooters parked outside, and far out at sea on the horizon the silhouette of a naval ship. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft daylight, calm civic scene, no recognisable faces.
cn-macau-handover: 1999, Macau: a December evening over the harbour, the old Portuguese colonial facades of the Senado Square area and the Ruins of St. Paul's lit up, fireworks over the Pearl River estuary, a large crowd of small figures watching along the waterfront, a modern bridge to Taipa. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, deep blue night and warm golden lights.
cn-falun-gong-ban: 1999, Beijing: an April morning along the long red wall and grey sidewalk of a street near Zhongnanhai, a very long line of ordinary people standing quietly in rows, seen from far away, police vans parked at intervals, willow trees and bicycles. A few spring blossoms hang over the wall. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, pale spring light, neutral and calm, no individual faces.
cn-sars: 2003, Guangzhou: a hospital corridor and entrance with medical staff in white protective gowns, masks and caps, a few patients in the waiting area, and outside on a busy subtropical street pedestrians in surgical masks under banyan trees and new tower blocks. A nurse sprays disinfectant at the doorway, and the street is unusually quiet. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, pale greens and whites, restrained and calm.
cn-shenzhou-5: 2003, Jiuquan launch centre in the Gobi: a white Long March rocket with its spacecraft lifts off from a tall gantry at dawn, a bright flame and long plume over the flat desert, distant observation buildings and small spectators, pale mountains on the horizon. No astronaut shown. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, soft pink dawn sky and golden flame.
cn-wenchuan-earthquake: 2008, Wenchuan, Sichuan: a steep green mountain valley after the earthquake, landslide scars on the slopes, collapsed concrete buildings in a small town by the river, rescue workers in orange and soldiers in camouflage clearing debris, blue relief tents in rows. No bodies shown. A helicopter flies low over the valley, and volunteers carry supplies. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, misty greens and greys, figures small.
cn-shanghai-expo: 2010, Shanghai: a vast expo park along the Huangpu River on a summer evening, a giant inverted red pavilion with stepped beams beside many colourful national pavilions, huge crowds of tiny visitors along elevated walkways, the river with ferries. Lights reflect in the river, and the towers of Pudong rise in the haze across the water. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, warm evening light, red and blue accents.
cn-high-speed-rail: 2011, the Yangtze delta near Shanghai: a sleek white high-speed train speeding along a long elevated concrete viaduct across flat green rice fields, canals and villages with white-walled houses, a modern station with a curved glass roof in the distance. Farmers in straw hats tend rows of vegetables beneath the viaduct. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, soft morning haze, motion blur of the train.
cn-xi-jinping: 2012, Beijing: the vast columned façade of the Great Hall of the People on the west side of Tiananmen Square on a clear November day, rows of black cars parked before it, small groups of people crossing the wide paved square, flagpoles and the gate tower in the distance. No people in close-up. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, cool autumn light, neutral composition.
cn-belt-and-road: 2013, Kazakhstan: a long freight train of shipping containers crossing the flat golden steppe near Astana, a new railway with pylons stretching to the horizon, the modern skyline of the capital far off, and herders on horseback watching from a low rise. Gantry cranes stand at a distant transfer yard. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, wide sky, ochre grass and pale blue.
cn-tu-youyou-nobel: 1970s, Beijing: a laboratory of Project 523, in a simple research room with glass flasks, a distillation apparatus and ether bottles on wooden benches, bunches of dried sweet wormwood plants hanging and spread on a table, an old notebook open beside a microscope, a window onto a Beijing courtyard. No people shown. A small heap of leaves rests in a ceramic bowl. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft greens and amber, quiet still life.
cn-two-child-policy: 2016, a Chinese city: a park on a spring afternoon, families with two young children, grandparents pushing a pram, a playground with slides, high-rise apartment towers and cherry trees behind, everyone small and seen from a distance. Children fly kites over the lawn, and a small lake reflects the trees. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, soft pastel light, everyday neutral scene.
cn-xinjiang-internment: 2017, the outskirts of a town in Xinjiang: a wide desert plain with rows of poplar trees and snow-capped Tianshan mountains, and in the distance a large walled compound of identical grey buildings surrounded by high fences and watchtowers, an empty road leading to the closed gate. No people shown. Painted as a sombre documentary watercolour, pale dust and grey tones.
cn-change-4: 2019, the far side of the Moon: a lunar lander on spindly legs stands in a grey cratered plain inside a large basin, a small six-wheeled rover leaving tracks across the dust, black sky, and a relay satellite shown as a tiny point of light, Earth not visible. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, soft greys and deep black, quiet scale.
cn-hong-kong-protests-2019: 2019, Hong Kong: a summer evening view across Victoria Harbour, the dense skyline of Central and Admiralty towers lit up, and on the wide harbourfront avenue below a vast crowd of tiny figures, many with umbrellas, filling the road from a great distance, ferries on the water. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, deep blue dusk and soft city lights, calm neutral view.
cn-hk-national-security-law: 2020, Hong Kong: an early summer morning at the Legislative Council complex at Tamar beside the harbour, the modern building with its open-door design and lawns almost empty, a few distant pedestrians and police barriers, grey sky and tall towers behind. Pigeons pace the empty forecourt, and harbour ferries pass behind. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, quiet grey tones, neutral and still.
cn-change-6: 2024, Siziwang Banner, Inner Mongolia: a small scorched return capsule lies on the green grassland under a white-and-orange parachute spread across the grass, recovery vehicles and a helicopter approaching from a distance at dawn, rolling plains to the horizon. Technicians in orange suits walk toward the capsule across the dewy grass. Painted as a muted documentary gouache illustration, soft dawn light, pale green and gold.
ca-namazga: c. 3000 BCE, Namazga-Depe at the foot of the Kopet Dag, Turkmenistan: a cluster of flat-roofed mud-brick houses with small courtyards on a low mound, farmers in simple wool tunics tending irrigated barley fields fed by mountain streams, a woman painting geometric black designs on a cream clay pot beside a kiln, goats and sheep grazing, bare brown mountains rising behind. Painted in a palette inspired by Namazga painted pottery, black and red geometric bands framing the scene on a cream ground, flat and decorative.
ca-altyn-depe: c. 2400 BCE, Altyn-Depe, southern Turkmenistan: a walled town of mud-brick houses and narrow lanes, potters and metalworkers busy in a craft quarter with kilns and smoke, and at the centre a tall stepped mud-brick temple platform with people climbing its ramps, the plain and irrigated fields stretching to the Kopet Dag foothills under a hot sky. Painted in an archaeological reconstruction style with the flat ochre, black and terracotta palette of Bronze Age Central Asian painted pottery and clay figurines.
ca-sintashta: c. 2100 BCE, Sintashta in the southern Urals: a round fortified settlement of timber-and-earth houses ringed by a ditch and palisade on the open steppe, smoke rising from bronze furnaces, men in felt and leather driving a light two-wheeled chariot with spoked wheels behind two horses across the grass, birch groves and a river nearby. Rendered in the style of Bronze Age steppe rock art and petroglyphs, ochre figures on a weathered stone surface, simple dynamic lines.
ca-bmac: c. 2000 BCE, Gonur Depe, Margiana: a great fortified palace-temple complex of mud brick with rectangular towers and gateways in a green oasis on the Murghab delta, priests in long fleece-patterned robes tending a fire altar, merchants unloading copper ingots, carnelian beads and seals from Bactrian camels and donkeys, desert dunes beyond the reed beds. Painted in a decorative style drawn from Oxus civilisation seals and composite stone figurines, flat warm earth tones with cream and dark brown.
ca-andronovo: c. 1800 BCE, the central Kazakh steppe: herders in felt caps and leather garments drive cattle, sheep and horses across a vast grassland, a light chariot with spoked wheels rolling ahead, timber-framed semi-sunken houses with smoke from a bronze-casting hearth, low burial mounds on the horizon under a huge sky. Rendered in the manner of steppe Bronze Age petroglyphs, ochre and dark red figures on smooth stone, with a wide simplified landscape.
ca-arzhan: c. 800 BCE, Arzhan in the Tuva mountain valley: an immense circular burial mound of stacked stones and timber chambers under construction on a broad grassy plain, mourners in felt coats leading many horses toward it, a ring of riders around the mound, dark larch forests and snow-tipped mountains behind, autumn sky. Painted in the stylised manner of early Scythian animal-style art, curled deer and horse motifs framing the scene, gold and earth tones.
ca-samarkand-founded: c. 700 BCE, the Afrasiyab hill above the Zarafshan valley: early settlers build thick mud-brick walls and houses on a loess plateau, men digging an irrigation canal from the river, fields of grain and orchards below, herders with sheep and Bactrian camels, snowy Pamir-Alay peaks far to the south. Painted in a style inspired by Sogdian murals of Panjakent, earthy reds, ochres and blues, flat figures in profile.
ca-cyrus-conquest: c. 545 BCE, the Syr Darya frontier near Cyropolis, Tajikistan: Persian soldiers in pleated tunics and soft felt caps with wicker shields and spears build mud-brick walls and towers of a new fortress on a terrace above the river, Bactrian and Sogdian envoys bring horses and tribute, the plain and distant mountains behind. Rendered in the style of an Achaemenid palace relief from Persepolis, processional figures in profile, stone-carved texture.
ca-tomyris: c. 530 BCE, the steppe east of the Caspian: on a wide dusty plain by a river, two great armies meet, Persian infantry with wicker shields and archers on one side, and Massagetae horsemen in pointed caps and scale armour with bows on the other, a mounted queen with her escort on a rise in the distance, dust clouds rising. No gore. Painted in the manner of Scythian gold-work motifs, horses and riders as golden relief figures on a dark ground.
ca-pazyryk: c. 400 BCE, the Pazyryk valley in the Altai: inside a log-lined burial chamber deep under a frozen stone mound, felt wall hangings with appliqué riders and griffins, a richly knotted pile carpet with red borders, deer and horsemen spread on the floor, a carved wooden coffin, horse harnesses with gilded fittings, frost crystals glittering on the timbers. Rendered in the flat, vivid style of Pazyryk felt appliqué and carpet design, red, ochre, blue and cream.
ca-issyk: c. 400 BCE, near Issyk in the foothills of the Tian Shan, Kazakhstan: a Saka burial procession on a grassy plain beneath snowy peaks, mourners in felt caps leading horses toward an earthen kurgan, a warrior laid out on a timber bier in a tall pointed headdress and a coat covered in thousands of small gold plaques shaped like animals, gold glinting in the sun. Painted in the manner of Saka and Scythian gold-work, animal-style ornaments framing the scene.
ca-jaxartes: 329 BCE, the Syr Darya near Khujand: Macedonian soldiers cross the broad river on rafts of hide stuffed with straw, catapults on the near bank shooting stones at Saka horse archers in pointed caps gathered on the far shore, Macedonian cavalry landing and the new walls of Alexandria Eschate rising on a terrace behind, distant mountains. Rendered in the style of a Greek red-figure vase painting, figures in profile on a black ground.
ca-spitamenes: 329 BCE, Maracanda in Sogdia: Sogdian horsemen in tunics and trousers with Saka riders in pointed caps sweep down from the hills toward the mud-brick walls of the city, a Macedonian garrison on the ramparts with long spears, dust and smoke over the irrigated fields and orchards of the Zarafshan valley. Painted in the manner of an early Sogdian mural from Panjakent, flat red and blue ground, riders in profile.
ca-roxana: 327 BCE, the Sogdian Rock in the mountains of Uzbekistan: after the fortress fell, a wedding feast in a hall of carved wooden pillars and hangings, Macedonian officers in short tunics and Bactrian nobles in long embroidered coats seated together, a young bride in a veil and jewellery seen at a distance, music and torches, snowy cliffs visible outside. Painted in the style of a Hellenistic Roman fresco, warm reds and ochres, soft modelling.
ca-ai-khanoum-falls: c. 145 BCE, Ai-Khanoum on the Amu Darya: a Greek city with a columned gymnasium, a theatre cut into the hillside and a palace courtyard with Corinthian capitals, smoke rising over the rooftops as nomad horsemen in felt caps pour through the gates, citizens in Greek chitons fleeing toward the river, the acropolis above. No gore. Painted as a Hellenistic mosaic with small coloured stone tesserae, ochres, whites and smoky greys.
ca-yuezhi-daxia: c. 130 BCE, Bactria: a long migration of Yuezhi nomads crosses the Amu Darya on rafts and at fords, horsemen in long belted coats and felt hats, wagons with felt tents, herds of horses and sheep, while on the far bank stand the walls and columns of a Greco-Bactrian town, its people watching. Painted in the manner of Bactrian silver and Kushan relief art, figures stacked in registers, warm silver-grey and gold tones.
ca-zhang-qian-yuezhi: c. 128 BCE, Bactria: a Han envoy in a long robe and cap holding a bamboo staff hung with yak-tail tassels, with a small group of weary attendants and a Xiongnu-born guide, is received in a tent camp of the Yuezhi beside a river, Yuezhi nobles in belted coats seated on felt carpets, fertile fields and distant walled towns behind. Painted in the manner of a Han tomb mural, ochre, black and red outlines on plaster.
ca-fayaz-tepe: c. 100 CE, Fayaz Tepe near Termez on the Amu Darya: a Buddhist monastery of mud brick and plaster with a domed white stupa, a courtyard with cells around it, monks in ochre robes carrying scrolls and walking toward a caravan on the river road heading east, painted Buddha figures on the walls, poplars and the wide river behind. Rendered in the style of a Gandhara relief carved in grey schist, figures with flowing drapery.
ca-kushano-sasanian: c. 240 CE, Bactria: a Sasanian prince in a tall crown with ribbons and a pearl-studded robe rides into a Bactrian city at the head of armoured cavalry, Kushan nobles in long coats bowing before the gate, a fire altar carried on a cart, mud-brick walls and a Buddhist stupa in the distance. Rendered in the style of Sasanian silverwork, a hunting-plate style relief of figures in gilt silver on a dark ground.
ca-kidarites: c. 360 CE, Bactria: Kidarite horsemen in long belted kaftans with elongated shaved heads and swords ride across a plain toward a Sasanian-held city of mud-brick walls, banners of cloth streaming, the Hindu Kush rising snow-capped behind, villagers watching from orchards. Painted in the manner of a Central Asian wall painting of the period, flat bands of red, ochre and lapis blue, riders in profile.
ca-hephthalites: c. 450 CE, Tokharistan: a Hephthalite ruler in a crowned headdress sits enthroned under a canopy in a tent palace on a broad valley, nobles in lapelled kaftans with daggers at their belts and envoys from oasis cities kneeling with gifts of silver bowls and silks, horses tethered outside, mountains around. Painted in the style of a Sogdian or Tokharian mural, mineral reds and blues, flat profile figures.
ca-peroz: 484 CE, near Balkh: a Sasanian army of armoured cavalry with long lances and elephants falls into a concealed trench on a dusty plain, Hephthalite horse archers on low hills around them, war banners toppling, dust clouds rising high, the scene viewed from far away. No gore. Rendered in the manner of Sasanian silverwork and rock relief, figures in gilded silver on a dark field.
ca-hephthalites-fall: 557 CE, near Bukhara: Western Turkic horsemen in long hair and fur-trimmed kaftans and Sasanian armoured cavalry advance from two sides across an oasis plain toward a Hephthalite camp of felt tents and banners, dust rising, the Amu Darya glinting in the distance. Painted in the style of a Sogdian Panjakent mural, warm red ground and blue accents, riders in profile.
ca-zemarchus: 568 CE, Ektag in the Tian Shan: a Byzantine envoy in a long silk tunic and cloak with his escort is led into a vast golden tent where the Turkic khagan sits on a gilded throne, Turkic nobles in kaftans seated on carpets, Sogdian merchants with bales of silk, snow mountains and grazing horses outside. Painted in the manner of a Sogdian mural, figures in profile, rich reds, golds and lapis blue.
ca-xuanzang-samarkand: 630 CE, Suyab in the Chu valley: a Buddhist monk with a bamboo-framed pack of scrolls on his back, with a few attendants and horses, approaches a vast encampment of felt tents of the Western Turkic khagan, Turkic riders in brocade kaftans with long braided hair around him, the snowy Tian Shan behind. Painted in the style of a Tang-dynasty Dunhuang cave mural, mineral blues and greens, ochre ground.
ca-afrasiyab-murals: c. 660 CE, the palace of King Varkhuman at Afrasiyab, Samarkand: inside a square hall a painter on a wooden scaffold finishes a vast wall painting of a procession of envoys, Chinese officials in black caps, Korean envoys with feathered caps, and Sogdian nobles on horses and camels, lamps lighting the brilliant colours. Painted in the style of the Afrasiyab murals themselves, deep lapis blue ground and rich ochre and white figures.
ca-qutayba: c. 709 CE, Bukhara: an Umayyad Arab army in mail coats and turbans with lances and black and white banners enters the oasis, the mud-brick walls of the citadel ahead, Sogdian nobles in kaftans standing at the gate to surrender, irrigated orchards and canals around the city. Painted in the manner of an early Islamic manuscript painting, flat colour and gold, figures in rows.
ca-paper: c. 751 CE, Samarkand: a workshop courtyard beside a canal where craftsmen beat mulberry bark and hemp rags in stone troughs, dip bamboo screens into vats of pulp and lay wet sheets to dry on walls in the sun, a Chinese craftsman in a Tang-style tunic showing Sogdian apprentices, poplars and a domed building behind. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, bright mineral colours, flat perspective.
ca-samanids: 819 CE, Samarkand: a caliphal envoy in black Abbasid robes presents a robe of honour and a document scroll to four brothers in Persian kaftans and turbans in a palace courtyard, Persian and Turkic guards around, the citadel walls and orchard gardens behind. Fountains play in the garden, and scribes wait with pens. Painted in the style of an early Persian miniature, fine detail, gold and lapis blue.
ca-samanid-mausoleum: c. 914 CE, Bukhara: a cubic brick mausoleum with a hemispherical dome stands in a garden, its walls woven in intricate basket-like patterns of fired brick that catch the light, craftsmen in turbans laying the last bricks on wooden scaffolding, mourners and visitors in long robes approaching. Painted in the manner of a Persian miniature, warm golden ochre and soft blue sky.
ca-rudaki: c. 930 CE, the Samanid court at Bukhara: in a pavilion garden with a pool, an elderly poet in a turban and long robe sits on a carpet playing a lute and reciting to a small gathering of courtiers, servants with bowls of fruit, cypress trees and roses around, seen from a short distance. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, jewel-like colours and gold, fine brushwork.
ca-satuq: c. 934 CE, Kashgar: a Turkic khan in a fur-trimmed kaftan and tall cap kneels in prayer on a carpet before a simple mud-brick mosque with a wooden porch, Turkic nobles and soldiers following his lead in rows, poplar trees, camels and the Pamir mountains beyond. Painted in the manner of a Persian miniature, bright reds and blues, flat perspective, figures small.
ca-bukhara-999: 999 CE, Bukhara: Kara-Khanid horsemen in Turkic kaftans with bows enter the city through a fortified gate, the great citadel on its mound and domed buildings behind, Samanid soldiers laying down their arms, townspeople in turbans watching from rooftops. Banners flutter above the gate, and merchants pull their camels aside to let the riders pass. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, gold sky, vivid colours, crowded composition.
ca-qatwan: 1141, the Qatwan steppe near Samarkand: Khitan horsemen of the Western Liao with long hair braids and lamellar armour sweep into a narrow valley, encircling Seljuk cavalry in turbans and mail with banners, dust rising, a mountain gorge around them, all seen from far above. Painted in the manner of a Yuan-dynasty hunting handscroll, fine ink line, light colour on silk.
ca-otrar-incident: 1218, Otrar on the Syr Darya: a large Mongol caravan of camels loaded with bales of silk, furs and silver is stopped at the gate of a walled oasis city, merchants in kaftans led away by guards, the governor's soldiers seizing the goods, the citadel above and desert beyond. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature from the Ilkhanid period, warm ochre and blue.
ca-bukhara-1220: 1220, Bukhara: smoke and flames rise over the domes and wooden roofs of a great city, Mongol horsemen in fur hats and lamellar armour gathered in the courtyard of a large mosque, townspeople in turbans assembled at a distance, the citadel walls behind. No gore. Painted in the style of an Ilkhanid Persian manuscript painting, as in the illustrated Jami al-Tawarikh, ink and colour.
ca-chagatai: c. 1225, Almaliq in the Ili valley: a vast Mongol encampment of white felt gers around a large golden tent on a green valley floor, horsemen and herds of horses, a Mongol prince in a fur-trimmed robe receiving homage from local Turkic and Uyghur chiefs, apple orchards and the Tian Shan snows behind. Painted in the manner of a Yuan-dynasty handscroll, fine ink line, soft colour on silk.
ca-golden-horde: 1242, Sarai on the lower Volga: a sprawling camp-city of white felt tents and wooden houses on the flat river plain, a great golden tent at the centre, Mongol nobles, Russian princes in fur caps and Muslim merchants arriving with gifts, boats on the wide river. Painted in the style of an Ilkhanid Persian miniature, gold and blue, flat stacked perspective.
ca-talas-kurultai: 1269, the Talas valley: a gathering of Mongol princes in fur-trimmed robes and hats seated in a circle on carpets inside a large white felt tent, attendants pouring kumis, swearing an oath with raised cups, horses tethered in rows outside on the green valley floor with mountains behind. Painted in the manner of an Ilkhanid Persian manuscript painting, rich reds and golds.
ca-masud-beg: c. 1271, Bukhara: a busy mint workshop with coin-makers in turbans hammering silver blanks between dies, scales and trays of new coins, a governor in Mongol-style robe inspecting, while outside a bazaar slowly revives with merchants, carts and rebuilt shops under domed roofs. Porters carry sacks of grain through the bazaar. Painted in the style of a Persian miniature, fine detail and flat colour, warm gold.
ca-black-death: 1338, the Chu valley near Lake Issyk-Kul: a quiet Nestorian Christian cemetery on a grassy hillside, rows of rounded grey gravestones carved with simple crosses, a few mourners in Turkic robes standing among them, the lake and snowy mountains beyond under a pale autumn sky. Painted in a restrained manner of a Central Asian wall painting, muted ochre, grey and blue.
ca-timur: 1370, Samarkand: a great assembly in a vast tent camp outside the city walls, nobles and commanders in Timurid robes and turbans kneeling in rows before a lame ruler seated on a throne under a canopy, horsemen and banners, the domes and walls of the city behind. Painted in the style of a Timurid Persian miniature, gold and lapis blue, crowded figures.
ca-terek: 1395, the Terek River in the North Caucasus: two vast cavalry armies clash on a broad river plain, Timurid horsemen with yak-tail standards and Golden Horde riders in lamellar armour, dust and banners, snow-capped Caucasus mountains behind, seen from a distance. No gore. The broad river winds through the plain beside the battle. Painted in the manner of a Timurid miniature from the Zafarnama, rich colours and gold sky.
ca-timur-death: 1405, Otrar: a winter camp of tents and wagons on the frozen Syr Darya plain, a large tent with its door flap closed, mourners in turbans and furs standing in the snow, and in an inset scene a ribbed blue dome of the Gur-e-Amir tomb in Samarkand. Painted in the style of a Timurid Persian miniature, white snow, lapis blue and gold.
ca-ulugh-beg-madrasa: 1417, the Registan of Samarkand: a great madrasa with a tall arched portal covered in blue and turquoise tilework with star patterns, minarets at the corners, students in turbans and robes entering with books, a teacher with an astrolabe in the courtyard, a market square in front. Painted in the style of a Timurid Persian miniature, intense turquoise, lapis and gold.
ca-ulugh-beg-observatory: 1428, Samarkand: inside a huge cylindrical observatory building on a hill, a giant curved marble meridian arc descends into a trench, astronomers in turbans with instruments measure the stars through a slit in the roof at night, scribes recording tables by lamplight. Brass astrolabes and armillary rings rest on a table. Painted in the style of a Timurid Persian miniature, deep blue night sky and gold stars.
ca-kazakh-khanate: c. 1465, the Chu valley: a long migration of Kazakh families on horseback and camels with felt yurts loaded on carts, herds of horses and sheep crossing a broad green valley, two leaders on horseback at the front, snowy mountains and wild tulips around. Painted in the manner of a Persian-Timurid miniature, bright greens and reds, figures in stacked rows.
ca-navoi: c. 1483, Herat: a poet in a turban and robe sits writing at a low desk in a garden pavilion with tiled walls, scrolls and manuscripts around him, a calligrapher and an illuminator working beside him, cypress and fruit trees and a pool, the city domes behind. Painted in the style of a Herat school miniature in the manner of Bihzad, refined detail, jewel-like colours.
ca-shaybani: 1500, Samarkand: Uzbek horsemen in tall caps and quilted coats ride through the gates of the city, the turquoise domes of the Bibi-Khanym mosque and the Registan behind, townspeople watching from rooftops, a small Timurid band riding away toward the hills. Dust rises from the hooves, and the orchards outside the walls are bare in autumn. Painted in the style of a Bukhara-school Persian miniature, bright mineral colours, golden sky.
ca-great-disaster: 1723, southern Kazakhstan: a long line of Kazakh families fleeing on camels and horses across a bare autumn steppe, felt yurts loaded on carts, herds thinning, smoke from abandoned camps behind, Dzungar horsemen far off on the horizon, an overcast sky. No gore. Children ride bundled on the camels. Painted in the manner of an eighteenth-century Central Asian miniature, muted ochres and greys, sorrowful mood.
ca-junior-zhuz: 1731, Irgiz on the Kazakh steppe: a Russian embassy in tricorne hats and long coats with a few soldiers meets Kazakh elders in fur hats and robes inside a large white yurt, an oath-taking with a book and a sword, horses and camels outside on the endless grassland. Painted as an eighteenth-century Russian engraving with fine cross-hatching, tinted in light watercolour.
ca-tashkent: 1865, Tashkent: Russian soldiers in white tunics and caps scale the high mud-brick walls of the city with ladders at dawn, smoke from guns, flat roofs and domes inside the walls, Uzbek defenders in turbans on the parapets, orchards around. No gore. Cannon smoke drifts over the walls, and cypress trees stand above the orchards outside the city. Rendered as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, fine lines and dramatic lighting.
ca-khiva-1873: 1873, Khiva: a Russian column with camels, cannon and soldiers in white tunics arrives before the mud-brick walls of the Itchan Kala, the turquoise-tiled Kalta Minor minaret and domes behind, freed Persian slaves walking out of the gate. Dust hangs over the column, and merchants and townspeople watch from the flat roofs. Painted in the manner of a nineteenth-century documentary watercolour by a travelling artist, warm desert light.
ca-geok-tepe: 1881, Geok Tepe in Turkmenistan: a vast mud-walled fortress on a desert plain at the foot of the Kopet Dag, Russian infantry columns in white caps advancing toward a breach blown in the wall, smoke rising, Turkmen horsemen in tall sheepskin hats at a distance. No gore. Russian cannon fire from a battery on the plain. Rendered as a nineteenth-century illustrated newspaper engraving, many small figures.
ca-1916-revolt: 1916, Semirechye: Kyrgyz and Kazakh families with camels, horses and loaded carts flee across a high mountain pass of the Tian Shan in early winter, a long line of people and animals against snowy peaks, smoke from distant villages in the valley below. Women carry infants wrapped in felt, and a dog follows the line. Painted as an early twentieth-century documentary watercolour, cold blue and grey, sorrowful scale.
ca-delimitation: 1924, Tashkent: Soviet officials and local delegates in tunics, skullcaps and robes gather around a large table covered with an outspread map of Central Asia with coloured regions, papers and pencils, a window looking onto a dusty street with poplars and a tram. A samovar and glasses of tea stand at the end of the table. Painted as a 1920s lithograph illustration, muted reds and ochres, no legible text.
ca-kazakh-famine: c. 1930, the Kazakh steppe: a vast empty grassland in winter, a few abandoned yurts and scattered bones of livestock in the snow, a small family on foot leading a thin camel toward a distant collective farm of low buildings, an overcast sky. No human corpses. A cold wind blows snow across the grass. Painted as a sombre 1930s watercolour, grey and pale ochre.
ca-aral: 1960 onward, the Aral Sea: rusted fishing boats stranded on cracked dry sand far from a retreating shoreline, a former harbour town with empty jetties, a camel walking across the old seabed, a thin line of water glinting on the horizon. Rusted hulls lean at odd angles, and salt dust drifts in a low wind. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, pale ochres and faded blues, wide empty landscape.
ca-independence: 1991, Almaty: a December day in the central square with snow, a crowd of small figures in winter coats and fur hats gathered before a modernist Soviet government building, new flags on tall poles, the snowy Zailiysky Alatau mountains rising behind the city. Steam rises from people's breath in the cold air, and fir trees line the square. Painted as a muted documentary watercolour, cold winter light, neutral calm.
eg-hieroglyphs: c. 3200 BCE, Abydos in Upper Egypt: inside a royal tomb workshop of mud brick at the edge of the desert, scribes and craftsmen with shaved heads and linen kilts carve tiny bone and ivory labels with simple pictorial signs of birds, snakes and reeds, pottery jars sealed with clay stoppers stacked beside them, palm trees and the Nile valley glowing in afternoon light outside. Painted in the style of an Egyptian tomb painting, flat ochre, black and red on a cream plaster ground, figures in profile.
eg-narmer-unifies-egypt: c. 3000 BCE, Hierakonpolis in Upper Egypt: a royal procession along the Nile, a king in a tall white crown, carrying a mace, walks behind standard-bearers, followed by courtiers and soldiers with bows, while reed boats glide on the river and captives from the delta kneel at a distance, papyrus marshes and desert cliffs around. Painted in the manner of early dynastic Egyptian relief and tomb painting, flat registers of figures in profile, ochre and black on limestone.
eg-memphis-founded: c. 2990 BCE, Memphis at the head of the Nile delta: workers in linen kilts build a great white-washed mud-brick wall and dikes beside the river, papyrus marshes of the delta stretching north and the narrow valley with desert cliffs to the south, boats with reed sails unloading grain, cattle herders in the fields. Painted in the style of an Old Kingdom Egyptian tomb painting, flat colours, registers of busy workers in profile.
eg-step-pyramid: c. 2670 BCE, Saqqara: a six-stepped limestone pyramid rising over the desert plateau, surrounded by a long white-panelled enclosure wall, hundreds of workers in linen kilts hauling blocks on wooden sledges up mud-brick ramps, an architect with a papyrus plan standing with officials at a distance, the green Nile valley below. Painted in the style of an Egyptian tomb painting, flat ochre, white and black on a cream ground.
eg-great-pyramid: c. 2560 BCE, the Giza plateau: the great pyramid of Khufu nearly complete, its smooth white limestone casing gleaming in the sun, workers hauling the last blocks up long ramps on sledges with ropes, overseers with staffs, the workers' town of mud-brick houses and bakeries below, the Nile and its flooded fields to the east. Painted in the manner of an Egyptian papyrus illustration, flat colour and fine black outlines.
eg-diary-of-merer: c. 2560 BCE, Wadi al-Jarf on the Red Sea coast: one continuous harbour scene. An official in a white linen kilt sits cross-legged under a reed shelter in the foreground, writing in a papyrus logbook, while nearby boatmen carry and load pale limestone blocks onto a wooden cargo boat moored at a stone jetty. Storage galleries cut into the rock face behind, turquoise sea and bare brown mountains beyond. No hieroglyph captions or lettering. A single unified scene filling the whole picture, no registers or dividing bands. Painted in the style of an Old Kingdom tomb painting, flat earth colours, profile figures.
eg-pyramid-texts: c. 2350 BCE, Saqqara: inside the dim burial chamber of the pyramid of Unas, its gabled ceiling painted with yellow stars on a dark blue ground, walls covered top to bottom in columns of carved blue-green hieroglyph-like signs rendered as an indistinct pattern, a stone sarcophagus in the corner lit by an oil lamp held by a priest in a leopard skin. Painted in the manner of an Egyptian tomb painting, deep blue, gold and green.
eg-old-kingdom-collapse: c. 2181 BCE, Memphis: a dry Nile bank with a low river and cracked fields, thin cattle and empty granaries, peasants in ragged linen gathering the last grain, a crumbling mud-brick temple wall behind, and in the distance the pyramid fields under a hot haze. No corpses. Painted in the style of a First Intermediate Period Egyptian tomb painting, simplified provincial figures, muted ochres and browns.
eg-herakleopolis-kings: c. 2160 BCE, Herakleopolis Magna in Middle Egypt: a provincial court in a mud-brick palace with painted columns, a king in a red crown seated on a throne under a canopy, officials and soldiers with spears and cowhide shields standing in rows, the Nile and the fertile Fayum fields beyond. Painted in the manner of a First Intermediate Period tomb painting, bold simple outlines, ochre, red and blue.
eg-theban-eleventh-dynasty: c. 2134 BCE, Thebes: a local ruler in a royal headcloth stands before the rock-cut tombs of the western cliffs, archers and soldiers with cowhide shields assembling on the riverbank, boats ready to sail north, palms and fields of the narrow valley around. Painted in the style of an Egyptian tomb painting from the Theban necropolis, rows of soldiers in profile, flat ochres and black.
eg-mentuhotep-reunites: c. 2055 BCE, Deir el-Bahari, Thebes: a terraced mortuary temple with colonnades and a square central structure built against towering golden cliffs, priests and officials in white linen processing up a ramp, a river procession of boats on the Nile below, groves of tamarisk trees planted before the temple. Painted in the style of a Middle Kingdom Egyptian tomb painting, flat colours and fine outlines.
eg-story-of-sinuhe: c. 1875 BCE, Itjtawy near the Fayum: a scribe in a linen kilt sits cross-legged with a papyrus roll on his lap, writing with a reed pen, and in the background a dreamlike vignette shows a traveller in a Canaanite striped wool tunic crossing the desert with donkeys and returning to an Egyptian palace. Painted in the style of a Middle Kingdom tomb painting, flat colours, delicate profile figures.
eg-senusret-iii-nubia: c. 1870 BCE, Semna at the Second Cataract: a massive mud-brick fortress with buttressed walls and towers on a granite outcrop above the rocky rapids of the Nile, Egyptian soldiers with bows on the battlements, Nubian traders with cattle and ivory waiting at the river gate, desert hills around. Painted in the style of a Middle Kingdom Egyptian tomb painting, flat earth tones.
eg-hyksos-rule: c. 1650 BCE, Avaris in the eastern delta: a city with mud-brick houses and a palace in a Levantine style, Asiatic rulers in colourful wool robes with mushroom-shaped hairstyles receiving tribute from Egyptian officials in linen, donkeys and storage jars in the courtyard, canals and palms. Painted in the manner of an Egyptian tomb painting, like the Beni Hasan scenes of Asiatic visitors, bright patterned colours.
eg-horse-chariot: c. 1600 BCE, Avaris in the Nile delta: on a dusty training ground beside palms, a light two-wheeled chariot with six-spoked wheels drawn by two horses races past, the driver with a composite bow, while grooms in kilts lead other horses from stables, Egyptian onlookers watching. Painted in the style of an Egyptian tomb painting, figures in profile, ochre, red and black.
eg-ahmose-expels-hyksos: c. 1550 BCE, Avaris: Egyptian chariots and infantry with axes and shields advance along the canals toward the walled Hyksos city, war boats with oars on the river, smoke rising beyond the walls, long lines of Asiatic people with donkeys and bundles leaving to the east. No gore. Painted in the style of a New Kingdom battle relief, figures in profile, flat colour.
eg-hatshepsut: c. 1479 BCE, Deir el-Bahari, Luxor: the terraced temple of Hatshepsut with long colonnades and ramps beneath golden cliffs, workers planting incense trees in pits on the terraces, and in the foreground ships returning from Punt unloading baboons, ebony, gold and potted myrrh trees. Painted in the style of the Punt relief at Deir el-Bahari, painted relief, ochre and blue.
eg-battle-of-megiddo: c. 1457 BCE, the Jezreel Valley: Egyptian chariots and infantry emerge from a narrow mountain pass onto the plain before the walled hill city of Megiddo, Canaanite chariots fleeing toward the city gates, horses and dust, olive groves and fields around. No gore. Painted in the style of a New Kingdom Egyptian battle relief, profile chariots and horses, flat ochre and blue.
eg-akhenaten-reform: c. 1350 BCE, Amarna: a vast open-air temple with rows of offering tables under the bright sun, the sun disc depicted overhead with long rays ending in small hands, a royal family seen small from behind making offerings, white houses and palaces along the Nile, cliffs on the horizon. Painted in the distinctive Amarna art style, relaxed elongated figures, warm golds and blues.
eg-amarna-letters: c. 1350 BCE, Amarna: in a mud-brick records office, scribes in linen kilts sort small clay tablets covered in wedge-shaped cuneiform marks rendered as an indistinct texture, baskets of tablets and seals, a foreign messenger in a Mesopotamian fringed robe delivering a new tablet, the city's white walls outside. Painted in the Amarna style of Egyptian art, warm ochre and blue.
eg-tutankhamun: c. 1332 BCE, Thebes: priests in white linen and leopard skins carry a gilded barque shrine of Amun out of the great temple of Karnak along an avenue of ram-headed sphinxes, crowds lining the route, a slender boy king seen small from behind in a blue crown at the head of the procession. Painted in the style of a New Kingdom tomb painting, rich golds, blues and reds.
eg-abu-simbel: c. 1264 BCE, Abu Simbel in Nubia: four colossal seated statues of a pharaoh carved into the face of a sandstone cliff above the Nile, workers on wooden scaffolding finishing the faces, boats on the river below, a smaller temple facade with standing figures nearby, golden desert. Painted in the style of a New Kingdom Egyptian tomb painting, flat ochre, blue and red.
eg-egyptian-hittite-treaty: c. 1259 BCE, Pi-Ramesses in the delta: Hittite envoys in long woollen robes and pointed shoes present a silver tablet to the Egyptian court in a columned hall with painted lotus capitals, Egyptian officials in pleated linen seated in rows, chariots and horses waiting outside. Painted in the style of a New Kingdom Egyptian tomb painting, flat colour, profile figures.
eg-sea-peoples: c. 1175 BCE, the Nile delta mouth: Egyptian warships with lion-headed prows and archers grapple with ships of the Sea Peoples, warriors in feathered headdresses and horned helmets, at a distance across the water, reed marshes on the shore. No gore. Egyptian archers line the shore, papyrus thickets bending in the wind. Rendered in the style of the Medinet Habu relief, carved and painted figures in profile, ochre and blue.
eg-deir-el-medina-strike: c. 1157 BCE, Deir el-Medina, Luxor: tomb workers in linen kilts sit down with their tools beside a temple wall at the edge of the desert, refusing to work, empty grain baskets beside them, officials and scribes arriving to listen, the workers' village of whitewashed houses in a desert valley behind. Painted in the style of a Ramesside tomb painting, flat ochre and red.
eg-tanis-and-thebes: c. 1069 BCE, Tanis in the delta: a temple city of reused granite obelisks and statues among marshes, a king's court in linen, and on the right half of the scene a distant Theban temple of Amun with priests in leopard skins, the two halves separated by the long Nile. Painted in the manner of a Third Intermediate Period papyrus illustration, fine black outlines.
eg-carthage-founded: c. 814 BCE, Carthage: Phoenician ships with curved prows and square sails anchored in a sheltered bay, settlers in long robes unloading jars and bales on the shore, a woman of rank in a fine robe seen from behind directing workers who mark out the line of a city wall with an oxhide strip, hills behind. Painted in the manner of a Phoenician ivory carving and painted pottery, warm ivory, red and ochre.
eg-piye-conquest: c. 727 BCE, Memphis: a Kushite army with archers and horses in Nubian dress and Egyptian-style kilts storms the white walls of Memphis from boats moored alongside, the city's temples and pyramids beyond, river crowded with ships. No gore. Palm groves line the riverbanks, and townspeople watch from the rooftops as Kushite standards are raised over the gate. Painted in the style of a Late Period Egyptian relief, figures in profile, flat earth colours.
eg-assyrian-conquest: 671 BCE, Memphis: Assyrian soldiers in conical helmets and scale armour with shields and spears march into a captured Egyptian city, a column of chariots, captives and booty of statues and gold carried out of temple gates, palms and the Nile. No gore. Scribes tally the plunder on the riverbank. Rendered in the style of an Assyrian palace relief from Nineveh, carved stone, figures in registers.
eg-psamtik-i: c. 664 BCE, Sais in the western delta: a pharaoh's court with Egyptian officials in linen and Greek mercenaries in bronze helmets and round shields standing in ranks, Greek trading ships moored at the river quay, a new temple pylon behind. Bales of goods and jars of oil are stacked on the quay. Painted in the style of a Late Period Egyptian painting combined with Greek black-figure vase motifs, flat colour.
eg-cambyses-conquest: 525 BCE, Pelusium in the eastern delta: Persian infantry with wicker shields and long spears, archers in pleated robes and soft caps advance across the marsh-fringed plain toward an Egyptian fortress, Egyptian troops with bows on the walls, dust rising. No gore. Persian cavalry wait on the flanks, and reed beds frame the scene. Rendered in the style of an Achaemenid relief from Persepolis, processional rows of soldiers in profile.
eg-hanno-the-navigator: c. 500 BCE, the Atlantic coast of West Africa: a fleet of Carthaginian galleys with oars and square sails sails past a green coast with mountains and a large river mouth, fires burning on the hillsides at night, settlers and sailors on deck. Painted in the manner of a Punic and Greek vase painting of ships, flat black, red and cream.
eg-nectanebo-ii: 343 BCE, the Nile delta near Pelusium: one continuous riverside scene. In the middle distance Persian troops in long robes and soft caps with tall spears march through the open gate of a mud-brick Egyptian fortress beside reed marshes. In the foreground on the river, an Egyptian king in a blue crown sits in a small papyrus boat with a few attendants, rowing away upstream, palms and a temple pylon on the far bank. No gore. A single unified picture, no panels, registers or dividing lines. Painted in the manner of a Late Period Egyptian papyrus illustration, flat colour and black outlines.
eg-alexander-conquers-egypt: 332 BCE, Memphis: a young Macedonian king in a cuirass and cloak seen from behind is received by Egyptian priests in white linen and leopard skins before a temple pylon, Macedonian cavalry and phalanx soldiers with long spears behind him, crowds watching, palms and the Nile. Incense smoke rises before the temple door. Painted as a Hellenistic mosaic with small stone tesserae, warm ochres and whites.
